text: {"lessons":["Monthly gains and losses have been uneven, and past price moves do not tell me what comes next; I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations.","Selling some Stock B and Stock E after gains and buying other stocks changed my holdings, but one subsequent period cannot show whether those trades were wise; I should judge trades against a clear allocation plan, not recent performance or average cost.","I should review diversification and risk periodically, but trade only when a considered plan calls for it, keeping in mind that losses weigh heavily on me."]}
